episodic.summary: Prior Oct 2026 SFO->FRA claim initially denied under WX-88 was overturned after tail log showed hydraulic actuator MEL fault triggered crew Part 117 timeout.
Transatlantic missed-connection denials citing ATC-14 frequently bundle minor 10-15m ocean-track spacing with 35-50m controllable gate catering or baggage holds.

semantic.rule: Routine component wear, hydraulic sensors, and avionics reboots are inherent to airline operations and NEVER qualify as extraordinary weather or unexpected flight-safety shortcomings.
Even when an FAA Ground Stop proves genuine extraordinary weather ($0 delay cash), charging same-cabin fare-difference surge on involuntary rebooking violates Contract of Carriage Rule 24.
Under C-452/13, arrival delay is measured at cabin door open, not touchdown or wheel-stop. If sensor uncertainty spans the 180-minute or 240-minute cliff, abstain and request timestamp proof.

precedent.summary: Commercial tail swap to charter route does not qualify as ATC congestion; awarded 75% cabin downgrade refund plus ancillary bag fee reversal.
